itinerary.summary: Experience the rich history and culture of Spain, indulge in delicious food and drink, and unwind in a beautiful setting. From the vibrant streets of Madrid to the stunning beaches of Barcelona, this 5-day trip offers the perfect blend of excitement and relaxation. With a moderate budget, you'll be able to enjoy the best of Spain without breaking the bank.

quickFacts.tippingNorm: It's customary to leave 5-10% in restaurants and bars.

packingTips: Pack light and breathable clothing for the summer heat
Don't forget to bring sunscreen and a hat for outdoor exploration
Comfortable shoes are a must for walking in Spain's historic cities

days.title: Madrid Arrival and Exploration
days.morning: Arrive in Madrid and check into your hotel in the Malasaña neighborhood
days.afternoon: Visit the Prado Museum and stroll through the Retiro Park
days.evening: Enjoy a traditional Spanish dinner and watch a flamenco show
days.foodPick: Try the famous tortilla española at Casa Mono

days.title: Madrid's Royal History
days.morning: Visit the Royal Palace of Madrid and the adjacent Sabatini Gardens
days.afternoon: Explore the historic center and visit the Plaza Mayor
days.evening: Relax with a drink at a rooftop bar in the Salamanca neighborhood
days.foodPick: Savor tapas at the Mercado de San Miguel

days.title: Toledo Day Trip
days.morning: Take a train to the historic city of Toledo
days.afternoon: Explore the narrow streets and visit the Cathedral of Toledo
days.evening: Return to Madrid and enjoy a traditional dinner

days.title: Barcelona Arrival and Beach Time
days.morning: Travel to Barcelona and check into your hotel in the Gothic Quarter
days.afternoon: Relax on Barceloneta Beach and take a stroll along the promenade
days.evening: Explore the lively El Raval neighborhood and enjoy seafood
days.foodPick: Dine at Can Culleretes, a historic restaurant in the Gothic Quarter

days.title: Barcelona's Iconic Landmarks
days.morning: Visit the iconic Sagrada Família and Park Güell
days.afternoon: Explore the modernist architecture and visit Casa Batlló
days.evening: Enjoy a farewell dinner in the trendy Eixample neighborhood
days.foodPick: Try traditional Catalan cuisine at Tickets Bar
